cfg_help_unknown: Existing preference. Changing it does not change other options.
help_prefix: Configures client prefix. Applies to future preset starts.
help_mudae_prefix: Configures mudae prefix. Applies to future preset starts.
help_roll_command: Choose wa, ha, or a custom name. Only local syntax is validated.
help_channel_id: Numeric channel identifier. Zero means unconfigured.
help_guild_id: Numeric server identifier; null leaves it unset.
help_min_kakera: Minimum for character selection during own rolls; the reset exception may apply.
help_wishlist: Manage character names without translation. Auto Steal shares this list.
help_series_wishlist: Manage series names. This list is independent of character preferences.
help_snipe_mode: Controls the character selection mode associated with the preset's wishlist.
help_series_snipe_mode: Enables selection using the series wishlist.
help_kakera_snipe_mode: Controls the character selection mode based on Kakera value and the configured threshold.
help_kakera_snipe_threshold: Independent value-selection threshold. Own rolls also check the effective minimum.
help_auto_pokeslot: Enables periodic Pokeslot; its interval is configured separately.
help_auto_steal: Controls the Auto Steal feature, which uses the preset's configured wishlist.
help_rolling: Configures automatic rolls. Applies to future preset starts.
help_only_chaos: Filters for chaos keys in the non-snipe claim path.
help_key_mode: Allows the key-oriented roll path when claim is unavailable.
help_dk_power_management: Manages DK using interpreted stock and power.
help_use_slash_rolls: Configures slash roll commands. Applies to future preset starts.
help_skip_initial_commands: Configures skip initial commands. Applies to future preset starts.
help_reactive_snipe_on_own_rolls: Configures selection during own rolls. Applies to future preset starts.
help_snipe_ignore_min_kakera_reset: Allows a zero minimum with claim available and its known reset within 60 minutes.
help_kakera_reaction_snipe_mode: Controls the Kakera reaction feature configured for this preset.
help_kakera_reaction_snipe_targets: Configures kakera reaction targets. Applies to future preset starts.
help_humanization_enabled: Configures variable waiting. Applies to future preset starts.
help_snipe_requires_claim_available: Preserved field that the current runtime does not use.
